games.name: SPielatus
games.description:
SPielatus – Your Game Night Organizer

You know the problem: Organizing a game night means endless messages across different chats, missed dates, and the eternal question "Who's available when?". SPielatus solves exactly that.

FLEXIBLE SCHEDULING
Propose multiple possible dates for your game night. Your fellow players sign up for the dates that work for them. Once the minimum number of participants is reached, the session is automatically confirmed – no more follow-ups needed. Optionally with waitlist support.

GROUP-BASED ORGANIZATION
Create groups for your different gaming circles – whether it's the weekly game night or the big annual session. Manage members, assign roles, and decide who can create game rounds or comment. Groups can be public, closed, or completely private.

When creating a game round, you decide which of your groups it will be published to – or whether it should be publicly visible to everyone.

POLLS & VOTING
Start polls directly in game rounds or in groups: Which game should we play? Who's bringing snacks? Which day should we meet? Three voting modes (single choice, top-3 ranking, multiple choice), anonymous voting possible, game options directly from BoardGameGeek or your group's collection.

INTEGRATION WITH BGG & BGSTATS
Link your BoardGameGeek account and bring all the game intelligence into the app:
• Your BGG collection is automatically imported and kept up to date
• Group collection: See which games are available in the group and who owns them
• Wish system: Mark games (including individual expansions) you'd like to play
• BGG poll options: Pick games with image and info directly from BGG
• BGStats import: Load a play file (.bgsplay) into a round – scores, winner and duration are taken over
• BGStats export: Log the result in BGStats with one tap – game, players, date and venue are pre-filled
• Record results manually: Even without BGStats, you can capture scores & winner directly

NOTIFICATIONS UNDER CONTROL
Over 40 configurable notification types keep you up to date – from new rounds in your groups to signups, waitlist movements and poll results, all the way to invitations and schedule conflicts. All granularly toggleable. The Action Center additionally bundles everything waiting for a decision from you.

MORE FEATURES
• Calendar export: Transfer confirmed and provisional dates directly to your device calendar
• Calendar subscription: iCal feed in Google Calendar, Apple Calendar or Outlook – new rounds and changes update automatically (two separate feeds for your own rounds and available group rounds)
• Result history: Game results remain accessible in every completed round
• Venue offers: Players can offer their place as the meeting location
• Conflict detection: Warnings for overlapping schedules
• Personal round defaults: Presets for new rounds (player counts, start time, duration etc.)
• Poll templates: Save recurring polls as personal templates
• Multilingual: German, English, French, Spanish

BY GAMERS FOR GAMERS
SPielatus was developed out of real need – by a board gamer who knew exactly these problems. The app is 100% free, ad-free, and respects your privacy.

Questions or feedback? Write to us at support@spielatus.ch

Stop the scheduling chaos and focus on what matters: playing together. Your game round organizer

games.name: Detective Me: Imposter Game
games.description:
Detective Me is a fun and entertaining game that is great for social gatherings. In multiplayer (online) mode, you can play with friends from different phones.
One player clicks "Create Game" and enters his name. A 6-digit code is generated. The other players click "Join Game", enter their name, game code, and join the game. When everyone joins, the host starts the game. By clicking "See Word", the program shows a word from the selected word list. Everyone sees the same word, except for one person, who sees "Imposter" instead of the word. During the game, you can make notes (visible only to you) that will help you navigate more easily when voting at the end. The game can be played in 2 ways: question and answer and one word/phrase at a time (as you wish). In the case of question and answer, the players take turns asking each other questions to try to find out who the imposter is, and the imposter tries to guess the word during the question and answer. During the question and answer, the player must try to answer the question given to him as accurately as possible so that the imposter cannot guess the word from his answer, but the other players understand the content of the answer. The questions are asked in turn, each player answers the question given to him and asks a question to whom he would like to, except for the person who asked him the last question.
It is forbidden to lie when answering the question. You must always answer correctly. You can answer approximately, not very specifically, but you cannot lie.
It is forbidden to ask similar questions - "What is the first letter of the word", "How many letters does the word consist of", etc. In the case of a word/phrase, the players take turns saying one word/phrase that is associated with the given word. When the time is up, voting begins
In the voting phase, you choose a suspicious player.
When everyone has voted, the host's "View Results" button becomes active.
The Results page displays:

who received how many votes,
who voted against whom.
If there is a player with the most votes, they leave the game
After the results, the host can:
continue the game, if they still want to continue finding the imposter
start a new game with the same word list
end the game
Additional information notes
Once the game has started, new players cannot join.
If a player leaves or is removed, they no longer participate in the current game.
If the application has been closed, it is possible to reconnect to the previous game (if the game is still active). Find the imposter, play in multiplayer mode.

games.name: WikiGacha
games.description:
知らなかった世界に出会える、知識カードコレクションゲーム。

WikiGachaは、オンライン百科事典のランダムな記事をカードに変換するガチャゲームです。パックを開封すると、さまざまなジャンルの記事が6段階のレアリティ（C〜LR）のカードとして登場。記事の内容に基づいてATK・DEFが決まるユニークなカードを集めて、自分だけのコレクションを作りましょう。

■ ガチャで知識と出会う
毎日届くパックを開けて、新しいカードをゲット。10回に1回は高レアリティ確定の金パックが出現します。

■ コレクションを充実させよう
集めたカードは図鑑に保存。レアリティでフィルターして、お気に入りのカードを見つけましょう。気になる記事はそのままブラウザで読むことができます。

■ カードバトルで腕試し
コレクションからカードを選んでオートバトル。ATKとDEFの合計値で勝敗が決まります。

■ デイリーミッション
毎日5つのミッションをクリアして、追加パックを獲得。遊ぶほどコレクションが広がります。

本アプリはWikimedia Foundationの公開APIを利用していますが、Wikimedia Foundationが承認・提供するものではありません。

games.name: Domino Association
games.description:
Domino Association is a relaxing and engaging word puzzle that challenges your mind through clever connections and satisfying logic.

On the board, you’ll find domino tiles — but instead of numbers, each half contains a word. Every word belongs to a specific category. Your goal is to match words by their shared category and clear all the tiles from the board.
Simple to learn, yet deeply satisfying to master, each level invites you to slow down, think clearly, and enjoy the process of finding the right connections.

How to Play:

- Search words that belong to the same category
- Tap on domino tiles to match them
- Clear all dominoes to complete the level
- Some tiles may block others, so the order of your moves matters. As levels progress, new categories and more complex layouts will test your attention and logic.


Think in Associations
Success comes from recognizing patterns and relationships between words. Some matches are obvious, while others require a bit more thought. Take your time and enjoy the “aha” moments as everything clicks into place.

Why You’ll Love It:

- Relaxing word gameplay with a fresh twist
- Clever category-based matching mechanics
- Clean, easy-to-read design for a comfortable experience
- Perfect balance of challenge and calm
- Ideal levels for daily mental exercise


Whether you’re unwinding after a long day or keeping your mind sharp, Domino Association offers a peaceful and rewarding puzzle experience built around the joy of words and logic. Match words by associations. Solve puzzles!
